title: add vpc control plane provisioning: interface endpoints, subnets, sgs, peering, route53
author: Asha Menon
description: Adds Terraform modules and installer glue to provision the VPC control plane for Private deployments. This PR implements multi-AZ subnet provisioning, AWS Interface and Gateway endpoints for required control plane services, security group templates with least-privilege defaults, cross-account VPC peering helpers, and automated Route53 private hosted zone setup and delegation for control plane DNS. Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private have requested a repeatable, supported terraform path that mirrors our recommended VPC topology and reduces manual post-install steps. This change factors networking into a reusable module, wires the private-installer to call the module during bootstrap, and adds safety checks and upgrade hooks so upgrades do not orphan route53 records or break peering. The description below summarizes the main changes, testing performed, and rollout notes. Checklist: 1) Terraform module with variables for az_count, cidr_map, interface_endpoints, gateway_endpoints, peer_specs and route53_zones. 2) Security group module with egress/ingress templates and audit tags. 3) Installer hooks to apply module outputs to Helm values for control-plane components. 4) Upgrade hooks to preserve route53 records and re-establish peering during cluster upgrades. 5) Docs: example tfvars, network diagram, and upgrade playbook. Related: ENG-4128 (module design), SUP-2201 (customer request).

review_comments: Liam Chen: Please ensure the interface endpoint list is configurable per-region; some regions lack certain endpoints. Author reply: Updated variables.tf and added region-conditional mapping; tests added for us-west-2 and eu-west-1.

Priya Kapoor: Security groups look permissive on the control-plane-to-storage path, can we lock down ports to the exact service ports? Author reply: Tightened SG rules, documented expected ephemeral ports and added tags for auditability.

Marco Alvarez: e2e flake seen in CI when peering creation collides with existing peering in account. Author reply: Added retry loop and idempotency logic in peering.tf, and a flag to skip peering for cross-account manual workflows.
OPS (internal): Can upgrade hook be run independently from installer? Author reply: Yes, added an 'upgrade-only' script and unit tests to validate route53 rollback path.
release_notes: - Add VPC control plane Terraform module for Private deployments (subnets, interface/gateway endpoints, security groups, peering, Route53 private zones). - Installer now invokes VPC module during bootstrap and exposes networking outputs to Helm values. - Upgrade hooks to preserve Route53 records and re-establish peering during upgrades.
